name: @micro-medic/shared-store
description: Framework agnostic shared store and global auth store and event bus for micro-medic MicroFrontend architecture
//build: No webpack, and no Module Federation. This is a library consumed from source through the `paths` map in tsconfig.base.json — like `api-client` and `shared-types` — so every consumer's own bundler compiles it. It used to also be a federated remote on :3005 purely because the plain-JS shell had no ts-loader; the shell is TypeScript now, so the port, the container and the placeholder harness page are gone.
